Program_Info.Program_Change_Info: Native configurable quota panel, account-isolated local history and on-demand Codex extensions.
Program_Info.Program_System_Requirements: Windows 11 x64. Sign in with the official Codex CLI. Per-user installer or portable ZIP; no administrator rights required.

English.Keywords: Codex quota, remaining quota, Windows taskbar, quota history, system tray, weekly quota, five-hour quota
English.Char_Desc_45: Codex quota on your Windows taskbar
English.Char_Desc_80: Native Windows 11 taskbar rings and bars for Codex weekly and 5-hour quota
English.Char_Desc_250: QuotaBar shows Codex weekly and 5-hour remaining quota on the Windows 11 taskbar. Choose rings or bars, open configurable details and view account-isolated local history. English and Simplified Chinese. Free software under GPL-3.0-or-later.
English.Char_Desc_450: QuotaBar is a lightweight native Windows 11 tool for Codex weekly and 5-hour remaining quota. Taskbar and tray share rings, bars and colors. Click for reset times, a configurable panel and 30-day account-isolated history. Optional local Codex App Server reads provide reset opportunities and Token activity. Missing data remains unavailable. Independently maintained by study-233, based on AI Limits by napxlexn.
English.Char_Desc_2000: QuotaBar displays Codex remaining quota on the Windows 11 taskbar with rings or bars. Select weekly, 5-hour or both periods. Native settings offer live previews and independent panel module visibility and ordering. The app follows Windows themes, taskbar auto-hide and DPI scaling. Local quota observations are retained for 30 days and separated by account. Optional Codex App Server reads provide reset opportunities and daily Token activity, with account checks and bounded helper lifetimes. Base requests reuse CLI logins without rotating tokens; the official CLI manages authentication for optional extension reads. QuotaBar does not start model turns or consume reset opportunities. Settings and history remain local. English and Simplified Chinese interfaces are available. Download the per-user installer or portable ZIP from study-233/ailimits releases. This distribution is not published to package managers or Microsoft Store. Free software under GPL-3.0-or-later. Based on AI Limits, original code copyright 2026 napxlexn; independently maintained by study-233.
